entities.name: Gerald Richard Barnes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gerald Richard Barnes is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as bishop of the Diocese of San Bernardino in California from 1996 to 2020 and as an auxiliary bishop of San Bernardino from 1992 to 1996.
